svg.title: Agent observability trace
svg.desc: A distributed trace follows a request through routing, model calls, tool calls, state checkpoints, policy checks, and output. Each span emits tokens, cost, latency, attributes, errors, and trace correlation into dashboards, replay, debugging, and evaluation.
svg.text: Agent observability follows decisions, not only final text
Trace/span attributes: tenant-safe IDs · prompt/context version · tool args/result class · tokens · latency · cost · error · policy decision
Dashboards, alerts, replay/debugging, trajectory evaluation, release gates
Redact or avoid sensitive content; correlate evidence and decisions with trace IDs, not raw private prompts by default.
